method: Exa discovery, primary-source reading, date/status checks and explicit limits. This is a bounded review, not an exhaustive consolidated all-state legal audit.

sources.title: Solid Waste Management Rules, 2026 (S.O. 388(E))
sources.publisher: MoEFCC; Gazette copy hosted by Maharashtra Pollution Control Board
sources.supported_claim: Replaces SWM Rules 2016; four-stream framework, bulk-generator definitions; separate waste rules excluded.
sources.limits: Official copy; extraction partial; local bye-laws and subsequent directions still require review.

sources.title: CPCB Solid Waste Rules index
sources.supported_claim: Official rules index now points to SWM 2026.
sources.limits: Index date is update date; not a permit register.

sources.title: Plastic Waste Management (Amendment) Rules, 2026, G.S.R. 237(E)
sources.supported_claim: Final amendment, not June 2025 draft; revises EOL/recycling/PWP definitions, recycled content, reuse, marking and local authority roles.
sources.limits: Read with base 2016 rules and other amendments; not evidence a particular resin/product or facility is approved.

sources.title: Legacy Centralized EPR Portal for Plastic Packaging
sources.supported_claim: Legacy operations discontinued 28 June 2026; points to Common EPR Portal; explains PIBO/PWP registration.
sources.limits: Legacy descriptive text can lag; do not implement old transaction links or treat it as current integration specification.

sources.title: Common EPR Portal
sources.supported_claim: Official target linked by plastics and e-waste portals.
sources.limits: Exa fetch timed out; link verified from CPCB portals. No external API entitlement checked.

sources.title: E-Waste Management System
sources.supported_claim: 2022 rules portal; manufacturer/producer/refurbisher/recycler registrations, certificates and returns; some SPCB consent verification unavailable.
sources.limits: Not proof of Luma integration access; page may contain elapsed deadline notices.

sources.title: E-Waste (Management) Rules, 2022
sources.supported_claim: Separate e-waste regime rather than general household scrap.
sources.limits: OCR poor in retrieved extract; commencement must be checked in original before rule engine use; use with amendments.

sources.title: E-Waste (Management) Amendment Rules, 2024, G.S.R. 164(E)
sources.supported_claim: Amends dismantler definition, permits ordered return-time relaxation and regulated certificate exchange platforms.
sources.limits: Portal filename says third amendment; operative legal title is Amendment Rules 2024; do not create arbitrary extensions or an unauthorized exchange.

sources.title: EPR Battery
sources.supported_claim: Batteries covered irrespective of chemistry/shape/use; producer, recycler, refurbisher registration roles.
sources.limits: Portal background says 22 Aug 2022; 2025 Gazette note says base notification 24 Aug 2022. Use Gazette for legal date.

sources.title: Battery Waste Management Amendment Rules, 2025, S.O. 958(E)
sources.supported_claim: Final labelling amendment allows specified QR/barcode/registration number routes and exceptions; base rules 24 Aug 2022 and amendments listed.
sources.limits: Not a replacement of 2022 regime; label and product-specific compliance require review.

sources.title: Guidance Document for Recyclers under Battery Waste Management
sources.supported_claim: Consent ID/state verification; procurement, recycling, recovered material sales, EPR wallet and return workflows; registration expiry/status.
sources.limits: Manual has recycler/refurbisher wording inconsistency; verify current portal and do not collect all identity fields in Luma by default.

sources.title: Waste Tyre EPR portal
sources.supported_claim: Schedule IX of HOWM amendment 2022; producer/recycler/retreader roles and certificate/retreading flows.
sources.limits: Dashboard zeroes cannot be treated as real zero registrations; do not substitute Luma tickets for certificates.

sources.title: Hazardous and Other Wastes amendment introducing Schedule IX (waste tyres)
sources.supported_claim: Notified tyre EPR framework.
sources.limits: Poor OCR; exact targets and publication date require direct PDF review before calculations.

sources.title: EPR Used Oil Management
sources.supported_claim: G.S.R.677(E) 18 Sep 2023 adds Chapter VII; base/lubrication oil producers and used-oil importers meet EPR through registered recyclers.
sources.limits: Current portal notice extends FY2025-26 return to 30 Nov 2026; verify signed order before automated deadline.

sources.title: HOWM Second Amendment Rules, 2023 (used oil)
sources.supported_claim: Primary used-oil EPR amendment linked by CPCB.
sources.limits: Poor OCR; read with official portal and later amendments.

sources.title: Environment Protection (End-of-Life Vehicles) Rules, 2025, S.O.98(E)
sources.supported_claim: Final rules apply to ELV chain, separately exclude batteries/plastic packaging/tyres/oil/e-waste; RVSF requirement and forms.
sources.limits: Cannot route complete vehicles to an ordinary scrap trader based only on GST.

sources.title: FAQs on EPR for End of Life Vehicles
sources.supported_claim: Producer/RVSF/bulk consumer registration; bulk consumer >100 vehicles; authorised downstream routing; category/year targets.
sources.limits: FAQ helps orientation; legal rules and current orders control.

sources.title: EPR End-of-Life Vehicles portal
sources.supported_claim: Official portal for ELV regime.
sources.limits: Public home page does not prove register coverage or programmatic integration.

sources.title: Hazardous and Other Wastes (Management and Transboundary Movement) Rules 2016
sources.supported_claim: Authorization, schedules, packaging labels, transport information and manifest system; inter-state duties.
sources.limits: Base rule only; not consolidated to 2026. Apply amendments and specific authorization conditions.

sources.title: CPCB hazardous waste Rules index
sources.supported_claim: Lists amendments through 12 Nov 2024, including waste tyre and used oil regimes.
sources.limits: Index last update is old; not proof no later amendments exist.

sources.title: Form 3: records of hazardous and other wastes
sources.supported_claim: Facility/address, authorization reference/date, schedule category, storage, source/destination, metric tonnes, dated processing/monitoring.
sources.limits: Blank form; does not contain actual facility evidence or signatory.

sources.title: Form 10: manifest for hazardous and other waste
sources.supported_claim: Sender/transporter/receiver authorization and contacts; vehicle, waste, quantity/container count, physical form, instructions, signatures and dates.
sources.limits: Actual transport/authorization/quantity/signatures needed; app transfer receipt alone is not compliance.

sources.title: MPCB Hazardous Waste registers and procedures
sources.supported_claim: Links authorized HW transporters, grant/refusal copies, recycler/preprocessor categories and TSDF information.
sources.limits: Maharashtra example only; individual order validity/category/capacity must be checked, no all-state claim.

sources.title: UP OCMMS e-waste authorization lookup
sources.publisher: Uttar Pradesh Pollution Control Board / NIC
sources.supported_claim: Public application ID/date search with status, approval/refusal date, expiry and authorization columns.
sources.limits: No actual entity searched. A legacy e-waste authorization listing does not replace current CPCB registration.

sources.title: Karnataka hazardous-waste authorization service
sources.supported_claim: Search excerpt lists Form1, Form4, Form10, storage photos, valid MOU with registered recycler/incinerator/TSDF.
sources.limits: Search-reviewed only; not a facility register. Do not mistake krocmms.nic.in Kerala KSPCB for Karnataka.

sources.title: CPCB archived latest notices
sources.supported_claim: July 2026 battery collection/handling/transport and recycling guidelines, March solar-PV handling guideline, August common plastic EPR registration notice.
sources.limits: Index evidence only; full guideline PDFs not retrieved here. Dates are upload dates, not necessarily legal commencement.

sources.title: CCTS offset authority is notified; a material ledger does not issue CCCs
sources.publisher: Ministry of Power; official Gazette copy hosted by BEE
sources.effective_date: Gazette issue dated 2023-12-19; no separate commencement clause identified in this amendment
sources.status: Notified amendment S.O. 5369(E), amending CCTS S.O. 2825(E) dated 2023-06-28
sources.supported_claim: Paragraph 11A permits non-obligated entities to register projects under published sectoral methodologies to seek CCC issuance. BEE identifies methodologies, with NSC-ICM recommendation and Central Government approval.
sources.implementation_implication: Keep impact estimates separate from official CCCs. Require an external registered project, approved methodology and official issuance evidence before labelling units as issued CCCs.
sources.limits: No Luma project registration, entitlement or private facility eligibility established. Original 28 June notification identified by amendment but not fetched separately.

sources.title: Offset procedure requires project registration, separate validation and verification, then BEE issuance
sources.publisher: Bureau of Energy Efficiency, Ministry of Power
sources.effective_date: 2025-03-27 (explicit statement on PDF printed page 9, physical page 11)
sources.status: Published detailed procedure, linked from current official BEE invitation; approval/publication corroborated by BEE letter of 2025-06-06
sources.supported_claim: Section A3 requires account registration, PDD/public comment, ACVA validation, BEE project registration, monitoring, a different ACVA for verification and Administrator review/issuance after NSC recommendation. A4.1 says project registration is limited to Indian firms. A4.2 gives 30 calendar days for PDD comments.
sources.implementation_implication: Build a document/evidence workflow with distinct pending, registered, monitoring, verified and issued states. A Luma administrator cannot replace ACVA or BEE decisions.
sources.limits: Exa timed out twice on scanned 84-page PDF. Downloaded official PDF and OCR-read physical pages 1-16 and 22-26. No claim that all procedural annexes or later amendments were fully audited.

sources.title: Current waste methodologies cover landfill methane and CBG; list is newer than the eight-methodology page
sources.publisher: Bureau of Energy Efficiency, Ministry of Power
sources.effective_date: Each linked methodology has its own adoption date
sources.supported_claim: Catalogue lists 12 methods including BM WA03.001 landfill methane recovery, BM WA03.002 flaring/use of landfill gas and BM WA03.003 production of compressed biogas. No generic dry scrap collection/sorting/recycling method was listed. The older /en/detailed-procedure-for-offset-mechanism-and-methodologies page lists only eight methods and is last updated 2025-05-13.
sources.implementation_implication: Use current methodology IDs and versions, not a broad Waste Handling label. Treat ordinary dry-material recycling as no approved matching methodology established by this review. A future proposal is not current eligibility.
sources.limits: Catalogue absence is limited evidence, not proof that no relevant sector-specific project or later approved method can exist. BM IN02.001 industrial efficiency/fuel switching could require separate facility-specific review.

sources.title: CBG method has a defined producer, baseline and anti-double-counting conditions
sources.publisher: Bureau of Energy Efficiency, Ministry of Power
sources.supported_claim: Method covers qualifying CBG plant activities. Paragraph 12 excludes hazardous waste/wastewater and requires not reducing recycling; paragraphs 12-14 define baseline/applicability and regulatory conditions. Paragraph 18 identifies the CBG producer as eligible claimant and permits sharing agreements to prevent double counting.
sources.implementation_implication: An aggregator's possession of a waste receipt is insufficient. Record the plant/project boundary, producer/claim agreements, eligible feedstock, baseline, metering and validation evidence before evaluating the method.
sources.limits: Only first 35,000 characters fetched; key scope, applicability and effective-date text reviewed, not a full calculation audit. No private CBG facility facts verified.

sources.title: CCC transactions require approved channels and external registry balances
sources.effective_date: Regulation 1(2): from Official Gazette publication; exact Gazette publication date not established in this review
sources.status: Final 2026 notification; distinguish from draft DN-PoCCC-2024.pdf
sources.supported_claim: Regulations 5-6 designate Grid India registry and BEE transaction-procedure role. Regulation 9 permits dealing only on Power Exchanges unless separately permitted; requires approved exchange rules, separate compliance/offset segments and registry balances. Regulation 11 defines one CCC as one tCO2e; price follows approved discovery. Regulation 10 refers banking/surrender to CCTS detailed procedures.
sources.implementation_implication: Do not present Luma's internal matching/payments/ledger as an authorised CCC exchange or registry. Store official registry identifiers, serials, units, mechanism, ownership and transaction evidence; do not invent a price or retirement confirmation.
sources.limits: Final notification is evidenced; exact gazette commencement needs verification. No CERC order authorising Luma or public transaction/retirement API identified.

sources.title: As of 23 October 2026, exchange contracts were still in approval proceedings
sources.document_date: Hearing 2026-10-23; record publication date not separately stated
sources.effective_date: Procedural directions in record; not a market-launch approval
sources.supported_claim: CERC observes BEE was yet to formulate the detailed transaction procedure under Regulation 6. PXIL, IEX and HPX petitions were admitted and proposals directed to stakeholder consultation; next hearing 12 January 2027.
sources.implementation_implication: Keep live CCC trading unavailable until approved operational channels and integration evidence exist. The regulation's existence does not prove operational exchange contracts or API access.
sources.limits: This is evidence about these petitions on the hearing date, not a definitive statement about every possible subsequent order. No later contrary official order found in this bounded review.

sources.title: Public onboarding evidence exists; public retirement API was not established
sources.publisher: Bureau of Energy Efficiency, Ministry of Power
sources.document_date: Page last updated 2026-04-13; linked invitation letter dated 2025-06-06
sources.effective_date: Invitation, not a legal commencement rule
sources.supported_claim: BEE invites non-obligated entity account registration using a linked Microsoft form. The linked official letter says March 2025 offset procedure was published with Central Government approval and asks interested entities to submit documents to BEE. BEE public navigation links indiancarbonmarket.gov.in.
sources.implementation_implication: Provide a guided external-registration and evidence record flow until authorised integration is established. Keep submission, account acceptance, project registration, issuance, transfer and surrender/retirement as separate evidence states.
sources.limits: No form submitted, account created, quota spent or authenticated portal inspected. Exa failed to fetch portal; direct HTTP returned 200 once. Public issuance/transaction/retirement API and Luma access rights remain unverified.

sources.title: CERC final reasons clarify market separation and single trade
sources.effective_date: Interpretive statement of reasons; underlying final regulation governs
sources.status: Final Statement of Objects and Reasons, not a draft proposal
sources.supported_claim: Paragraphs 2.7-2.8 say compliance and offset CCCs are not interoperable, independent accounting applies and issued/credited CCCs can be traded only once.
sources.implementation_implication: Do not build a freely re-tradable token/credit wallet or combine compliance and offset balances. Require a current legal/registry review before any transaction implementation.
sources.limits: Reasons explain final regulations. This does not establish a generic voluntary retirement endpoint or permissions for Luma.

sources.title: October 2026 transaction procedure is a draft under consultation
sources.publisher: Bureau of Energy Efficiency, Ministry of Power; official Indian Carbon Market portal
sources.effective_date: Not effective final procedure: comments invited until 2026-11-02, then submission to CERC for approval
sources.status: Draft consultation, explicitly stated in signed cover letter
sources.supported_claim: Cover letter invites public comments and says the procedure will go to CERC for approval after consultation. Proposed procedure is for Compliance Mechanism transactions and includes non-obligated purchasers. It proposes API-based sharing from ICM Portal to ICM Registry, automatic registry account replication and unique CCC identification numbers.
sources.implementation_implication: Track as a proposal only. It is not a public API authorisation, a live exchange approval or an offset transaction/retirement implementation contract. Do not implement a live integration based on this draft.
sources.limits: Exa fetch failed; official PDF downloaded directly, body extracted with pdftotext and first two scanned cover pages read with OCR. Full draft not audited. The 23 October CERC record and 19 October draft establish lack of a completed approved procedure, rather than proving no document was being drafted.

sources.title: Local Government Directory
sources.supported_claim: LGD provides maintained administrative location identifiers. Do not treat old Census location lists or GST codes as a current jurisdiction directory.
sources.limits: No bulk live district import or integration entitlement verified.

sources.title: Convex backup and restore
sources.supported_claim: Dashboard backups can include files. Scheduled backups require a paid plan. Code, environment and pending jobs need separate recovery planning.
sources.limits: Does not establish this account plan, configured schedule, off-site custody or successful cloud restore.
